mappings.name: Whisper transcription — a clip with no speech in it
mappings.comment: Whisper answers the subtitle boilerplate it was trained on when it is given silence, which is how « Thank you for watching » reached the owner's chat (retour de recette MAG-222). The agent refuses such a transcript on the scores below, and this mapping is how a journey gets one: it matches a clip whose bytes carry the marker, so the case is reproducible without a sound card and without ordering tricks. Priority 1 so it wins over the catch-all below.

mappings.name: Whisper transcription — one fixed sentence
mappings.comment: verbose_json rather than text since MAG-222's retour de recette: no_speech_prob and avg_logprob are what tell a sentence from an invention over silence, and they come with this format alone. The scores here are those of speech really heard.
